[Atlas Shrugged Part 1](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6W07bFa4TzM) (I’m guessing they weren’t brave enough to run with the tag line ‘Non-Contradiction’). I agree with what [Tyler has to say](http://www.marginalrevolution.com/marginalrevolution/2011/02/the-atlas-shrugged-movie-trailer.html). It needs a deco rendering. For a novel that has the cinematography and direction more or less written into it, there’s not much excuse.
